test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Directions: Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

They are providing shelter to the homeless.

options.text: The homeless are been provided shelter.
The homeless will be provided shelter.
The homeless are being provided shelter.
The homeless have been provided shelter.

solution:
The correct answer is '**The homeless are being provided shelter**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In Active Voice, a sentence emphasizes the subject, performing an action.
 
• In Passive Voice, a sentence emphasizes the action or the object of the sentence.
 
• The given sentence is in the active voice and it is in the present continuous tense.
 
• When we convert this sentence into a passive voice, the subject 'They' of the active voice becomes the hidden object 'them', the object 'the homeless' becomes the subject.
 
• The active format "**are + present participle** (providing)" should be converted into the passive format "are + being + V3 (provided)".
 
• This is the active and passive voice rule for the present continuous tense.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.
